query:
The family seems to assume that when Ngozi cooks for Christmas, everyone eats what she makes. Is that assumption accurate for all members?

Options:
A. Adaora
B. Chidi
C. Emeka
D. Ngozi
context:
[1] (about=Adaora, episodic, t8 @2025-03-03T20:25:00) Mum I wanted to mention something. For Christmas I was thinking of bringing a dish actually. A lentil thing I've been making
[2] (about=Adaora, episodic, t8 @2025-03-03T20:28:00) I know but I've been eating a bit differently lately and I just want to make sure there's something I can...
[3] (about=Emeka, episodic, t8 @2025-03-03T20:35:00) We'll figure it out when we're all together 😊 Mum there will be enough food for everyone regardless
[4] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t8 @2025-03-03T20:36:00) Ok. When you come home Adaora you will tell me everything ❤️ I am your mother
[5] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t0 @2025-02-03T14:22:00) Adaora I will be making egusi, jollof, the full thing. You know I cook for three days before Christmas 😂❤️
[6] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t8 @2025-03-03T20:26:00) Adaora I am cooking! You don't need to bring anything 😂❤️
[7] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t0 @2025-02-03T14:26:00) Of course! My family must eat well 😂 Tobenna you're eating for three when you come
[8] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t6 @2025-02-24T19:09:00) Of course I will make moi moi! I always do. You will also eat the goat Adaora 😂 Tobenna what do you want?
[9] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t5 @2025-02-24T18:55:00) My darlings 🥰 Adaora how is the thesis going? You have been so quiet this week and I know that means stress. Also before I forget, tell me what you want me to cook for Christmas. Emeka I know you want the goat 😂
[10] (about=Adaora, episodic, t6 @2025-02-24T19:11:00) I mean I'll have whatever there is, just suggesting the beans side would be nice
agent_answer:
The assumption is **not accurate for Adaora**. She explicitly says she wants to bring her own lentil dish because she has been "eating a bit differently lately," and she asks for beans as an alternative to the main meal Ngozi cooks.

- **Adaora** ❌ — wants something other than what Ngozi makes.
- **Emeka** ✅ — appears fine with whatever Ngozi cooks ("there will be enough food for everyone").
- **Ngozi** — she is the cook herself, so the assumption about "everyone eats what she makes" doesn't apply to her in the same way.
- **Chidi** — there is no information in the conversation about Chidi's eating preferences at Christmas.

So the answer is **A. Adaora**.
